product_metadata.title: Simple Trending 3-Tier Stackable Shoe Rack, Expandable & Adjustable Shoe Shelf Storage Organizer, Wire Grid, White
features: 【3-TIER SHOE RACK】This shelves fit boots, high heels or slippers and hold 9-12 pairs of shoes.

【Multifunctional】In the kitchen, set the kitchenware and cutlery. In the living room, the shelves can hold sundries.Put it in the closet and keep the clothes neat. Make the utility room looks cleaner.
【STACKABLE AND EXPANDABLE FOR DIY】2 sets can be stacked vertically to get a complete 6-tier shoe rack or bridged horizontally to expand the unit.
【DURABILITY】 Made of thickened metal tube with power coated finish which is smooth and with strong corrosion resistance.
【EASY ASSEMBLY】 Simple structure design makes it very easy to assemble. USPTO: 00939253
description: What does this Simple Trending DIY shoe rack have to offer?
This 3-tier shoe rack provides shelves for keeping flats, boots, high heels, kids’ shoes. Two sets can be stacked or placed side by side to create a large capacity shoe rack and fit your space.

You can place this rack anywhere you want, such as in the entryway, closet, garage, or living room; also great as a storage shelf for dry food, books, games, toys, craft supplies, etc. Will you find any more possible uses? Just find out yourself with this Simple Trending versatile utility rack.
Color: White Material: Metal Product Size: 26.8" * 11.4" * 19.5" Weight: 5.5lbs Max. Load Capacity of Each Shelf: 22 lb
1x 3 Tiers Shoe Rack 1 x Assembly Manual 1 x Allen Key 4 x Metal Connectors ( for stacking )
